design.purpose: asking for an appointment because things at work keep slipping (traits: task_initiation: moderate; working_memory: weak)

text: Hello, I'm very sorry to trouble you, and I hope this is the right way to ask for an appointment. I'm 27 and have been registered with you since university, though I've only been in twice. Three weeks ago I started my first job, at a logistics firm, and honestly I think some of this is just that it's new and I'm trying hard not to get things wrong. The first week was fine. I was early every day and finished my induction modules by the Friday, which I was pleased about. Since then a few things have slipped. Last Tuesday my manager asked me to send a supplier a corrected spreadsheet, and I knew exactly what to do, but it sat open on my screen until the next afternoon before I sent it. Twice I've walked into the stock room and forgotten what I went in for, which I know is small. My manager has been kind about it, and the planner I bought last week has helped with remembering meetings. I'm sorry this is so long. Could I please have an appointment, either early morning or after 5pm, as I would rather not explain to work yet?
